# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Module 4: Eurasian Wonders, Masterpieces, Holy Sites & Chivalric/Orthodox Orders (oe_wnd_, Slot 70). Generated by gen_eurasia_wonders_orders.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 70 entry point (world line, takes NO BYZ main-line lock; deduplicated per calendar month).
oe_wnd_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_wnd_ran_m ?= oe_wnd_m_now } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_ran_m value = oe_wnd_m_now }
        if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_runs }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_runs add = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_runs value = 1 }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    current_month = 5
                    has_global_variable = oe_wnd_force_tick
                }
            }
            remove_global_variable = oe_wnd_force_tick
            oe_wnd_annual_check = yes
        }
    }
}

# O(1) explicit-anchor annual check: 12 Wonders + 4 Chivalric Orders + 2 Orthodox Religious Orders.
oe_wnd_annual_check = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w1_done }
            location:constantinople = {
                has_owner = yes
                has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_w1_done value = 1 }
        location:constantinople.owner = {
            trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w2_done }

    # Chivalric Order 1: Constantinian St. George (Constantinople anchor)
    if = {

            location:constantinople = {
                has_owner = yes

        location:constantinople.owner = {

    # Chivalric Order 2: Varangian Brotherhood (Constantinople or Moscow anchor; staggered after St. George)
    if = {

            location:constantinople = {
                has_owner = yes

                    oe_wnd_is_varangian_eligible = yes
                    OR = {
                        has_variable = oe_wnd_ord_stgeorge
                        AND = { NOT = { has_or_had_tag = BYZ } NOT = { has_or_had_tag = ROM } }

                }
            }
        }
        location:constantinople.owner = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_wnd_ord_varangian value = 1 }

        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {

                has_owner = yes

            }
        }
        location:buda.owner = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_wnd_ord_dragon value = 1 }

        }
    }
    # Orthodox Religious Order 1: Athonite Hesychast Order (Mount Athos anchor; 0 DLC lock)
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_ro_hesychast_founded }
            location:mount_athos = {
                has_owner = yes
                owner = { oe_wnd_is_hesychast_founder = yes }
            }

# Found Athonite Hesychast Order on Mount Athos (or non-capital fallback) with chosen calling.
oe_wnd_found_hesychast_order = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_ro_hesychast_founded value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            owns = location:mount_athos
            location:mount_athos = { location_can_host_order_holding_trigger = yes }
        }
        location:mount_athos = {
            found_religious_order = {
                type = religious_order_type:oe_orthodox_hesychast_order_type
                calling = calling:$calling$
                religion = religion:orthodox
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                location_can_host_order_holding_trigger = yes
            }
            found_religious_order = {
                type = religious_order_type:oe_orthodox_hesychast_order_type
                calling = calling:$calling$
                religion = religion:orthodox
            }
        }
    }
}

# Found Orthodox Sepulchre Military Order on Jerusalem/Antioch (or non-capital fallback).
oe_wnd_found_sepulchre_order = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_ro_sepulchre_founded value = 1 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            owns = location:jerusalem
            location:jerusalem = { location_can_host_order_holding_trigger = yes }
        }
        location:jerusalem = {
            found_religious_order = {
                type = religious_order_type:oe_orthodox_sepulchre_military_order_type
                calling = calling:oe_sepulchre_wardens_calling
                religion = religion:orthodox
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            owns = location:antioch
            location:antioch = { location_can_host_order_holding_trigger = yes }
        }
        location:antioch = {
            found_religious_order = {
                type = religious_order_type:oe_orthodox_sepulchre_military_order_type
                calling = calling:oe_sepulchre_wardens_calling
                religion = religion:orthodox
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        random_owned_location = {
            limit = {
                location_can_host_order_holding_trigger = yes
            }
            found_religious_order = {
                type = religious_order_type:oe_orthodox_sepulchre_military_order_type
                calling = calling:oe_sepulchre_wardens_calling
                religion = religion:orthodox
            }
        }
    }
}

# ---- TEST ONLY helpers (called from DEV_LINES wnd* buttons on Page 69 top half) ----
oe_wnd_test_tick = {
    remove_global_variable = oe_wnd_ran_m
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_force_tick value = 1 }
    oe_wnd_monthly = yes
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.90
}

oe_wnd_test_reveal = {
    location:constantinople = { discover_location = root }
    location:dadu = { discover_location = root }
    location:moscow = { discover_location = root }
    location:samarkand = { discover_location = root }
    location:alexandria = { discover_location = root }
    location:cairo = { discover_location = root }
    location:genoa = { discover_location = root }
    location:hangzhou = { discover_location = root }
    location:baghdad = { discover_location = root }
    location:delhi = { discover_location = root }
    location:jinjiang = { discover_location = root }
    location:lhasa = { discover_location = root }
    location:mount_athos = { discover_location = root }
    location:mecca = { discover_location = root }
    location:medina = { discover_location = root }
    location:rome = { discover_location = root }
    location:antioch = { discover_location = root }
    location:jerusalem = { discover_location = root }
    location:belgrad = { discover_location = root }
    location:buda = { discover_location = root }
}

oe_wnd_test_build_byz = {
    location:constantinople = {
        discover_location = root
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_wnd_b_owner }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_wnd_hagia_sophia_dome
                    owner = scope:oe_wnd_b_owner
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w1_done } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_w1_done value = 1 }
                scope:oe_wnd_b_owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.1 }
            }
        }
    }
    location:constantinople = {
        discover_location = root
        if = {
            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_wnd_b_owner }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_theodosian_bastion_ring } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_wnd_theodosian_bastion_ring
                    owner = scope:oe_wnd_b_owner
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w2_done } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_w2_done value = 1 }
                scope:oe_wnd_b_owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.2 }
            }
        }
    }
}

            limit = { has_owner = yes }
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_wnd_b_owner }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:oe_wnd_delhi_imperial_observatory } }
                construct_building = {
                    building_type = building_type:oe_wnd_delhi_imperial_observatory
                    owner = scope:oe_wnd_b_owner
                    instant = yes
                    cost_multiplier = 0
                    cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event"
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_wnd_w11_done } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_wnd_w11_done value = 1 }
                scope:oe_wnd_b_owner = { trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.11 }
            }
        }
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_wnd.90
